# Quests — side quests

### headings and nothing else, then run:  python3 tools/dialogue.py import -->

**How to edit this file**

- Change only the text underneath a `###` heading. That text is what the game
  says.
- Leave the `##` headings, the `<!-- key: ... -->` comments and the `###`
  field names alone. They are how the text finds its way home.
- Keep any `%s` and `%d` exactly as they are. The game fills them in with a
  name or a level, and a line that loses one will break.
- Blank lines inside a passage are kept. Leading and trailing ones are not.
- Speaker names are part of the line ("Elder: Good morning."). The dialogue
  box splits them off itself, so keep the `Name: ` prefix.

## Feathers on the Rise

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_feathers_on_the_rise.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_feathers_on_the_rise.tres</sub>

Main quest · **Giver:** hermit

### title

Feathers on the Rise

### summary

The hermit on the hill wants the Gustpips off the rise so he can gather his herbs in peace.

### offer_line

Hermit: Eh? A visitor. Well, since you're here. The Gustpips on the rise have gone mad this spring, diving at anyone who comes up for herbs. Chase a few off and an old man can gather his roots again.

### accept_option

I'll chase them off.

### refuse_option

Another time.

### accepted_line

Hermit: They're quick and they strike from above. Earth knocks them out of the air.

### refused_line

Hermit: Hmph. Young people.

### reoffer_line

Hermit: Gustpips still diving at me. Well?

### progress_line

Hermit: Still feathers everywhere, I see.

### continue_option

Give me time.

### abandon_option

I'll leave the rise alone.

### abandoned_line

Hermit: Of course you will.

### complete_line

Hermit: Ha! Quiet on the rise. Here, coins I had no use for. Mind how you spend them.

### done_line

Hermit: The roots are coming up well this year.

## Field Medicine

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_field_medicine.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_field_medicine.tres</sub>

Side quest · **Giver:** farmer

### title

Field Medicine

### summary

The Farmer wants to see a salve actually work before he buys any for his mule.

### offer_line

Farmer: My mule got nipped by a Loambuck. The Apothecary swears by her salves, but I have never seen one work. Patch up one of yours and show me?

### accept_option

I'll show you.

### refuse_option

Ask the Apothecary.

### accepted_line

Farmer: Salves come from the Apothecary at the market. Use one on a companion that took a knock, from your satchel or mid-fight.

### refused_line

Farmer: She would just try to sell me three.

### reoffer_line

Farmer: Changed your mind about showing me that salve?

### progress_line

Farmer: Used a salve yet? A companion has to be hurt for it to do anything.

### abandoned_line

Farmer: Fine, fine. The mule will live.

### complete_line

Farmer: Well I never. Closed right up. Here, for your trouble. I'll be buying a tin for the mule.

### done_line

Farmer: The mule is doing better. Still bites, though.

---

## Ink and Oath

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_ink_and_oath.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_ink_and_oath.tres</sub>

Side quest · **Giver:** scribe

### title

Ink and Oath

### summary

The Scribe has inked a fresh batch of scrolls and promises a third to anyone who buys two.

### offer_line

Scribe: A new batch, still drying. Buy two and I will write you a third myself. Every Oathkeeper should carry spares.

### accept_option

Deal.

### refuse_option

Not today.

### accepted_line

Scribe: Excellent. Forty coins a scroll, and mind the wet ink.

### refused_line

Scribe: The offer keeps. The ink does too, mostly.

### reoffer_line

Scribe: Still interested in two scrolls and a third for free?

### progress_line

Scribe: Two scrolls from this stall, and the third is yours.

### abandoned_line

Scribe: Another time, then.

### complete_line

Scribe: As promised. This one I inked slowly. It should hold.

### done_line

Scribe: If a scroll crumbles, it was the creature that refused, not the ink.

## The Leaf Hat

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_leaf_hat.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_leaf_hat.tres</sub>

Side quest · **Giver:** child

### title

The Leaf Hat

### summary

The child on the wall saw a Loambuck with leaves on its back and wants to see one up close.

### offer_line

Child: The Loambuck I saw had leaves on its back like a little hat. If you bound one, I could see it up close! Please?

### accept_option

I'll bring one home.

### refuse_option

Maybe another day.

### accepted_line

Child: Really? They live in the meadow past the gate. Weaken it first, my mother says, and then the scroll.

### refused_line

Child: Fine. I'll just watch from the wall then.

### reoffer_line

Child: Did you change your mind about the Loambuck?

### progress_line

Child: Did you find one? With the leaves?

### continue_option

Still looking.

### abandon_option

I can't catch one.

### abandoned_line

Child: Oh. Okay. Maybe I'll see one from the wall again.

### complete_line

Child: It has the hat! It has the leaf hat! Here, I saved these coins for bread, but this is better.

### done_line

Child: Tell the Loambuck I said hello.

## Leech Shallows

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_leech_shallows.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_leech_shallows.tres</sub>

Main quest · **Giver:** ranger

### title

Leech Shallows

### summary

Leechlings in the reeds east of the pond have been bleeding the Ranger's traps dry.

### offer_line

Ranger: Something else, if you've the time. Leechlings in the reeds east of the pond keep draining my traps before I can check them. Clear a couple out?

### accept_option

Sure.

### refuse_option

Not now.

### accepted_line

Ranger: They're slippery, and water shrugs off your Emberling's fire. Earth hits them well.

### refused_line

Ranger: Fair enough.

### reoffer_line

Ranger: Leechlings are still at my traps. Interested now?

### progress_line

Ranger: Any luck in the reeds?

### continue_option

Still looking.

### abandon_option

I'll leave them be.

### abandoned_line

Ranger: Suit yourself.

### complete_line

Ranger: My traps held something besides leeches this morning. Thank you. Take a scroll; I never use them.

### done_line

Ranger: The reeds are clear. For now.

## The Crossing

<!-- key: quest:quest_side_the_crossing.tres -->

<sub>game/content/quests/quest_side_the_crossing.tres</sub>

Main quest · **Giver:** merchant

### title

The Crossing

### summary

Rillfins at the pond crossing have soaked the Merchant's last two deliveries. He wants the crossing quiet before the next caravan.

### offer_line

Merchant: Two deliveries soaked through, and both times it was Rillfins at the pond crossing. Chase a couple off before the next caravan and there is coin in it for you.

### accept_option

I'll clear the crossing.

### refuse_option

Not right now.

### accepted_line

Merchant: The pond is east of the road, past the gate. Mind your footing; the shore is slick.

### refused_line

Merchant: Suit yourself. The bread will be damp again, then.

### reoffer_line

Merchant: Still Rillfins at the crossing. Reconsidered?

### progress_line

Merchant: Any luck at the crossing?

### continue_option

Working on it.

### abandon_option

I'll leave the crossing be.

### abandoned_line

Merchant: Hm. Well, damp bread is still bread.

### complete_line

Merchant: Dry as a bone, the last crate. You have earned this, and a scroll from the one I never opened.

### done_line

Merchant: The caravan came through dry. First time in a season.
